reasons.restricted_suffix: image outside an allowed prefix - real deed images may not be committed; use a redacted or synthetic sample (R30.2)
reasons.weight_suffix: model weights - publish via the checkpoint registry with provenance and a memorization probe, not git (R40.9, R30.6)
reasons.epilogue: Deed images contain names, signatures, and biometric thumb impressions. Git history is permanent. Unstage these files. If you believe an exception is warranted, it needs human sign-off recorded in docs/DATA.md.
